{{Youmay|the medical procedure|the [[Heat-sealer|device]] found in a [[Malkite poisoner's kit]]}}
A '''heat-seal''' was applied to a bone that had been reconstructed, after replacing the marrow. The heat-seal prepared the bone so that muscle, flesh, and skin could then be re-formed around it. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]] had the bones of his right arm heat-sealed during [[Reconstructive surgery/Legends|reconstructive surgery]] to repair significant injuries he had sustained during a prison break.
